caseName: La Crosse Telephone Corp. v. Wisconsin Employment Relations Board
caseNameFull: La Crosse Telephone Corp. v. Wisconsin Employment Relations Board and International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers, Local B-953, A. F. of L. v. Wisconsin Employment Relations Board
attorneys: Donald J. Martin for the Communications Workers of America.

opinions.text:
Motion of Communications Workers of America, Division 23, to be made a party of record and to participate in oral argument denied. Leave is granted to file a brief as amicus curiae.

Reported below: 251 Wis. 583, 30 N. W. 2d 241.
